prompts.description: Create lib/ingredient-i18n.ts: English->Korean map for all catalog ingredients + a localizeIngredientName() helper
prompts.prompt: Create a NEW file lib/ingredient-i18n.ts. Do NOT modify any other file in this step. Import the Language type from @/lib/meal-store. Define `const INGREDIENT_KO: Record<string, string>` mapping these EXACT English names (case-sensitive) to Korean: 'Chicken breast':'닭가슴살', 'Eggs':'달걀', 'Canned tuna':'참치캔', 'Greek yogurt':'그릭요거트', 'Salmon':'연어', 'Ground beef':'다진 소고기', 'Ribeye':'꽃등심', 'Shrimp':'새우', 'Turkey breast':'칠면조 가슴살', 'Whey protein':'웨이 프로틴', 'White rice':'흰쌀밥', 'Oats':'오트밀', 'Sweet potato':'고구마', 'Banana':'바나나', 'Brown rice':'현미밥', 'Quinoa':'퀴노아', 'Apple':'사과', 'Granola':'그래놀라', 'Olive oil':'올리브유', 'Peanut butter':'땅콩버터', 'Avocado':'아보카도', 'Mixed nuts':'믹스넛', 'Almond butter':'아몬드버터', 'Walnuts':'호두', 'Chia seeds':'치아씨드', 'Broccoli':'브로콜리', 'Spinach':'시금치', 'Carrot':'당근', 'Cucumber':'오이', 'Bell pepper':'파프리카', 'Tomato':'토마토', 'Mushroom':'버섯', 'Asparagus':'아스파라거스', 'Kale':'케일', 'Brussels sprouts':'방울양배추', 'Zucchini':'애호박'. Export `function localizeIngredientName(name: string, lang: Language): string` returning, when lang === 'ko', INGREDIENT_KO[name] ?? name; otherwise the original name unchanged. Pure function, server-safe — do NOT add 'use client'. No `any`. Verify: npm run build passes and lib/ingredient-i18n.ts exports localizeIngredientName.

prompts.description: Seed both AI routes' ingredient allow-list in Korean so generated meal/swap ingredient names come back Korean
prompts.prompt: Building on lib/ingredient-i18n.ts, make the AI routes feed Korean ingredient names when language is 'ko'. (A) Edit app/api/generate-meal-plan/route.ts: add `import { localizeIngredientName } from '@/lib/ingredient-i18n'`. Find `const ingredientsSnippet = selectedIngredients.slice(0, 10).join(",")` and change it to map each name first: `selectedIngredients.slice(0, 10).map((n) => localizeIngredientName(n, language)).join(",")` (the `language` variable already exists in this scope). (B) Edit app/api/swap-meal/route.ts: same import; find where `selectedIngredients` is built from `userProfile.selectedIngredients.slice(0, 10).join(", ")` (used in the `Available ingredients:` line) and map each name through localizeIngredientName(n, language) before join (the `language` variable already exists at the top of the handler). Do NOT change the prompt text, the English path (localizeIngredientName returns names unchanged when not 'ko'), validation, or anything else. Verify: npm run build passes; generating a fresh meal plan in Korean returns Korean ingredient names in meal.ingredients[], and Korean-language swaps do too.

prompts.description: Localize adjustMacros correction ingredients (Olive oil / White rice) to Korean
prompts.prompt: Edit ONLY app/api/generate-meal-plan/route.ts. The adjustMacros function injects correction ingredients with hardcoded English names `name: "Olive oil"` and `name: "White rice"`. Add a third parameter `language: 'en' | 'ko'` to the adjustMacros function signature. Inside it, replace `name: "Olive oil"` with `name: localizeIngredientName("Olive oil", language)` and `name: "White rice"` with `name: localizeIngredientName("White rice", language)` (localizeIngredientName is already imported from the previous step; if not, add `import { localizeIngredientName } from '@/lib/ingredient-i18n'`). Update the adjustMacros call site (the `adjustMacros(coercedDays, { ... })` call) to pass `language` as the new third argument. Do NOT change the amount strings, the `category` values, the macro math (fatPerMeal/carbsPerMeal), or the 0.8 ratio thresholds. Verify: npm run build passes; a Korean plan whose fat/carbs fall below 80% of target shows '올리브유'/'흰쌀밥' as the correction ingredient instead of English.

prompts.description: Display-time backstop: render ingredient names via localizeIngredientName in grocery list + daily view (fixes existing English plans without regeneration)
prompts.prompt: Add a deterministic display backstop so catalog ingredient names render in Korean even for plans generated before this change. This is DISPLAY-ONLY — do NOT mutate stored weekPlan data and do NOT touch anything passed into validation. (A) components/grocery-list.tsx: add `appPrefs` to the `useMealStore()` destructure (currently `{ weekPlan, setCurrentStep, userProfile }`), add `const language = appPrefs.language`, and `import { localizeIngredientName } from '@/lib/ingredient-i18n'`. Wrap every displayed ingredient name with localizeIngredientName(item.name, language) — both in the rendered grocery rows AND in the share/copy text builder (the .map that outputs `- ${item.name}: ...`). Leave the category headers (already localized via t()) untouched. (B) components/daily-view.tsx: it already has `const language = appPrefs.language`; add the same import and locate where each meal's ingredients are listed (meal.ingredients[].name) and wrap the displayed name with localizeIngredientName(name, language). Do NOT change amounts or macros. Verify: npm run build passes; an existing English-generated meal plan now shows catalog ingredient names (닭가슴살, 흰쌀밥, 올리브유, etc.) in Korean in both the daily view and grocery list without regenerating.
